resources.string: Android needs these before Stay Focused Kids can share app use with your parent.
Which app is on your screen.
To show the block screen when an app your parent blocked opens, and to share screen time with them.
Reads messages, passwords or typing. Never sold. Shared only with the parent you link.
Stay Focused Kids uses the Accessibility service
Strongly recommended on this phone: without it, Android may stop blocking in the background.

Stay Focused Kids sees which app is on your screen so it can block the apps your parent chose. It never reads messages, passwords or typing. Nothing is sold, and it is shared only with the parent you link.
Always shown while this phone is linked to a parent.
Shows a persistent notification and shares screen time with the parent this phone is linked to, until the child or parent unlinks it. Runs only while linked.
